patterns.title: كنتُ
patterns.explanation_ar: نستخدم I was لبيان حالة أو دور أو مكان في وقت ماضٍ. لا تثبت was وحدها أن الحالة انتهت نهائيًا أو أنها لم تعد صحيحة الآن.
patterns.explanation_en: Use I was to place a state, role, or location at a past time. Was alone does not establish whether it remains true today.
patterns.contrast_ar: I was في الماضي، بينما I am للحاضر.
patterns.contrast_en: Use was for a past state with I; use am for a present state. Was is followed by a complement here, not a second finite verb.

patterns.form: I went + to + place / I went home
patterns.title: ذهبتُ
patterns.explanation_ar: went هي صيغة الماضي من go، ولا نقول goed. نقول went home دون to؛ أما went to the house فتتضمن to لأن house اسم مكان عادي.
patterns.explanation_en: Use went, the past form of go, for a completed trip. Home is used without to after go/went in went home.
patterns.contrast_ar: I went yesterday للماضي؛ I go every day للعادة.
patterns.contrast_en: Went is the irregular past of go. Use to before most destination nouns, but not before home in went home.

patterns.title: قد / من المحتمل
patterns.explanation_ar: نستخدم may للتعبير عن احتمال، وقد تبدو أكثر رسمية من might؛ ولها أيضًا استعمال مستقل للإذن.
patterns.explanation_en: Use may followed by a base verb to express possibility. May can also express permission.
patterns.contrast_ar: It may rain احتمال؛ May I leave? طلب إذن، وهذا معنى مختلف.
patterns.contrast_en: Here may expresses possibility. May can express permission in other contexts, but I may arrive late here is not a request for permission; May I leave? is a separate function.
